bullet_points: Style of emceeing based on high-octane, ad-libbed vocals has flourished thanks to its unique way of captivating crowds  For the 2015 freshmen cohort of the history degree programme at the University of Lagos, their classmate’s first-semester presentation was so captivating that they began calling him Toby Shang, after the 16th-century Chinese dynasty he had focused on.
His crowd engagement that day had been harnessed from his high school days as a ginger-man (energiser) in a three-man band and as a private tutor.
By his final year at university, his viral catchphrases and infectious energy had resulted in a hit song, Shedibalabala.

stories.title: Ebola cases in Kenya highlight US failures amid Trump cuts to key services

It highlights the diminished role the US has played in the worsening Ebola outbreak by building a controversial quarantine center in Kenya, pulling back health support globally, and banning travelers from certain countries.
All of this has also reduced the ability to identify and respond to the outbreak and exacerbated mistrust.
